local.about: Country pricing (owner, 2026-11-13: "they are all same prices in MENA, but add USA", "currency according to country"). A buyer is quoted and charged in its country's own currency: packages[].prices.<CUR> is that country's NET price (EGP = Egypt, SAR = Saudi Arabia, AED = the UAE, USD = the USA). Egypt and the USA are typed, one line each. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are a RULE (owner 2026-11-13: "I need Saudi and UAE to just be 100% more expensive than Egypt, that's it"): local.countries.<CC>.price_rule = 2 x Egypt's price, converted at local.rates.per_usd and rounded to the nearest 5; their stored SAR / AED numbers are GENERATED by portal/scripts/derive-gulf-prices.cjs (run it after changing an EGP price or a rate; test/pricing.test.cjs fails when they differ). Never type a SAR or AED price. VAT IS A SWITCH, OFF TODAY (owner 2026-11-14: "not registered" in Saudi Arabia, the UAE or Egypt): the package price is the final amount the client pays, in every country. VAT is charged in a country ONLY when local.countries.<CC> has BOTH a vat_rate_pct above 0 AND a non-empty vat_registration; then total = net + VAT, VAT = net x vat_rate_pct / 100 rounded half-up to 0.01 on the whole order (portal/lib/local-price.cjs chargedVatPct). With no registration number the rate is inactive reference only: no VAT line, no "+ VAT", no total different from the price. To turn VAT on in one country later: type that country's registration number into its vat_registration, then republish the price list (portal/scripts/publish-pricing.cjs) and update the Launchpad copy. The USA has no VAT here (vat_rate_pct 0; US sales tax is not handled). The country comes from the client (SA / AE / EG / US only, never typed free text); any other country pays the USD price (packages[].price, kept equal to prices.USD; a test fails when they differ) with no VAT. Read by portal/lib/local-price.cjs and mena-batch/app/core/local-price.mjs, the Launchpad's pricing.py (checkout, a byte-for-byte copy of this file; it reads local.countries.<CC>.vat_rate_pct and charges it only with a vat_registration, as local-price.cjs does; none today, so no VAT) and the site's data/pricing.json (republished from this file by publish-pricing.cjs, which writes each country's CHARGED vat_pct: 0 while unregistered). vat_registration: null = not registered (today, all four countries): no VAT is charged, shown or printed there.

rates.about: Owner-editable: units of each currency per 1 US dollar, used ONLY to turn Egypt's price into the Saudi and UAE prices (price_rule). SAR 3.75 and AED 3.6725 are the official pegs. EGP 53.901088 is the rate this price list already used (ExchangeRate-API open feed snapshot 2026-11-07T00:02:31Z): TO BE CONFIRMED BY THE OWNER. After a change, run node portal/scripts/derive-gulf-prices.cjs.
